<subject>Hawthorne Legal Services?</subject>
<body>
Antony,

Hawthorne Legal Services, on behalf of the Corporate Advisory Division, will be inviting tenders for external counsel engagement. We are currently considering limited advisory mandates, and would like to establish a retainer agreement. We would appreciate a prompt update regarding the status of the retainer contract between your firm and the Corporate Advisory Division. If your legal team has any questions or issues, please reach out to Dale Fletcher at Hawthorne Legal Services on +44 7817 646361.

To address any compliance or credit concerns, the division is preparing a full credit and compliance dossier, which we will share once finalised.

Please do not hesitate to call if you need further information.

Thank You,  
Judith Dennis  
Contract Administration  
Hawthorne Legal Services  
+44 7817 646361
</body>
